name: Cloudflare GitHub OAuth MCP Server
description: A reference MCP server for Cloudflare Workers that provides remote connection support with integrated GitHub OAuth authentication. It enables developers to build and deploy authenticated remote tools with user-specific access controls and persistent state management.
